title: State-Dependent Visibility of Non-Commutative Ordering in Quantum Dynamics
summary: A nonzero commutator proves that two orderings differ as operators, but it does not ensure that a physical state can reveal the difference. We ask when non-Abelian ordering information becomes dynamically invisible. For Hermitian operators $B$ and $C$, we compare the evolutions generated by the opposite-order products $M=(B+iC)(B-iC)$ and $\widetilde M=(B-iC)(B+iC)$, and define their operational visibility from the minimum overlap of the output states over a normalized time window.
